title: Morning rush in Chicago: every train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Chicago, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every train inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Chicago city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Red Line, Blue Line, Brown Line, Green Line, Orange Line and Pink Line, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 148 trains at 8:10 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Columbus Day (October 12).
